details.s: Thrór I was the King of Durin's Folk, the son of Dáin I and brother of Frór and Grór, known for ruling Erebor, the Lonely Mountain. He was the father of Thráin II, whose son was Thorin II.
f: King of Durin's Folk, King under the Mountain
